purpose: Build configuration with Vite 5, Vitest, jsdom, and ESLint dependencies and scripts
content:
{
  "name": "tic-tac-toe-advanced",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Tic-Tac-Toe with advanced features: scoreboard, move history, blitz timer, CPU player",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite",
    "build": "vite build",
    "preview": "vite preview",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:watch": "vitest",
    "test:coverage": "vitest run --coverage",
    "lint": "eslint src --ext .js"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "vite": "^5.0.0",
    "vitest": "^1.0.0",
    "jsdom": "^23.0.0",
    "@vitest/coverage-v8": "^1.0.0",
    "eslint": "^8.50.0"
  }
}
